sheets.title: Custom setup after applying External connectors — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Before, applying the Connections capability added one tab, Connectors. After, a Storage tab follows it: the vault's location is part of the ceremony.

sheets.title: The Storage tab — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: The bucket's own form, the same one Settings › Capabilities › Local storage opens: endpoint, region, bucket, access key id, secret access key (a secret field, sealed on this device apart from the public ones). Nothing is chosen for the person; with no bucket saved the vault stays in this browser.
